Minor because 0/0:=0 is the single canonical choice every B-spline treatment uses and the crash makes the issue immediately self-diagnosing, but the formula as printed is mathematically undefined on the benchmark's own inputs.

fix.after:
B_{i, p}(t):=\frac{t-t_i}{t_{i+p}-t_i} B_{i, p-1}(t)+\frac{t_{i+p+1}-t}{t_{i+p+1}-t_{i+1}} B_{i+1, p-1}(t) .

Whenever a fraction has a zero denominator (repeated knots), that term is defined to be zero (convention 0/0 := 0).
